senses.gloss: --one of the 8 मुहूर्तस् of the afternoon. Br. III. 3. ३९; वा. ६६. ४०.
--a son of दिवोदास; his descendents became भार्गव Brahmanas. M. ५०. १३.

--a resident of ब्रह्मक्षेत्र; a वासिष्ठ and a sage;
1: वा. ५९. १०६; Br. II. ३२. ११६.
Purohita of इक्ष्वाकु.
2: M. १२. 4-5.
--a daughter of दक्ष and a wife of Dharma; mother of प्रसाद. भा. IV. 1. ४९-50.

(I)--(also कौषारव); a son of मित्रा; a siddha; himself a पुराण of information;
1: भा. III. 4. ३६; VI. १५. [१४]; III. 7. ४२.
went with कृष्ण to मिथिला; met कृष्ण on the eve of his departure to Heaven, and was ordered to be the preceptor to Vidura; the latter met him on the Ganges and after describing the creation of the world, answered Vidura's questions.
2: Ib. X. ८६. १८; III. 4. 9 and २६; 5. 1 and २२-36; 8. 1ff.
Taught him आत्म [page२-७४०+ २८] विद्या and told him that the goal was Hari;
3: Ib. I. १३. 1; १९. १०; II. १०. ४९.
was invited for the राजसूय of युधिष्ठिर.
4: Ib. X. ७४. 7; XII. १२. 8.
(III)--a pupil of पराशर; enquired of him as to the origin of the world. Vi. I. 1. १०.
